sentences.text: Order Sheet  12.03.2025 Heard Mr. Manoj Paranjpe, learned counsel for  the petitioner and Mr. Sangharsh Pandey, learned  Government Advocate, appearing for th  State/respondent No.1.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that she is challenging the FIR, which has been lodged by her husband/respondent No.2 bearing Crime No.0014/2025 registered at Police Station Kotwali,
Raipur, District Raipur, C.G. for offence punishable under Sections 420, 467 and 468 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 (for short, 'IPC') alleging that he has obtained second birth certificate of the child showing the birth of place at Raipur, against whom, the petitioner has already lodged the FIR for the offence under Sections 498-A, 323, 506, 354A, 377 and 34 of the IPC as well as Section 4 of the Muslim Woman (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019 against respondent No.2 and his family members, in which charge-sheet has been filed against the husband/respondent No.2.
He further submits that the petitioner has already been enlarged on anticipatory bail.
Mr. Sangharsh Pandey, learned Government Advocate has put in appearance on behalf of respondent No.1, hence, there is no need to issue notice to respondent No.1.

List the matter thereafter.
